ui.R
content:
library(shiny)

source("Q2A.R");

# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Quantitative Genetics: Insect Population Sampling"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      numericInput("student_id", "Enter your 7-digit Student ID:", 
                   value = 0, min = 1000000, max = 9999999),
      actionButton("generate", "Generate Patches"),
      br(), br(),
      helpText("Click on any patch to see the insects inside"),
      verbatimTextOutput("status_info"),
      uiOutput("validation_message")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("patch_plot", click = "patch_click", height = "600px")
    )
  )
)
